one_liner: Vonage offers a REST API with Basic, JWT Bearer, and request‑signing auth, free trial access, and a community Postman MCP.
gating_notes: Free sandbox/trial available; no paid gating required.
oauth_details: JWT Bearer authentication is supported via Vonage Applications; no OAuth2 flow is provided.

auth_methods.quote: Basic Authentication sends your API Key and API Secret Base64-encoded in the Authorization header. Callbacks/webhooks are not supported. Receiving event or summary callbacks requires JWT Bearer authentication, along with a Vonage Application configured with a Status URL.

primary_auth.quote: Verify supports two authentication methods: Basic authentication and JWT Bearer authentication.

existing_mcp.note: Search results show an official Vonage MCP Server published on developer.vonage.com and a GitHub repository under the Vonage organization, indicating it is published by the vendor itself.

pass_history.why: Quote lists Basic and JWT Bearer, not HMAC signature.
